name: ncs_register_jobseeker
description: Registers a new jobseeker on the NCS portal by creating an account. No prerequisite tools are required. It does NOT log the user in or return a session_token.

mobile_number.description: Mobile number linked to the account

name: ncs_login_jobseeker
description: Authenticates a registered jobseeker and returns a session_token. Must be called before ncs_apply_job, ncs_check_application_status, ncs_enroll_skill_training, ncs_register_job_fair, and ncs_update_profile. It does NOT register a new user.

name: ncs_update_profile
description: Updates jobseeker profile details such as qualifications, skills, and experience. Must be called after ncs_login_jobseeker and before ncs_apply_job to ensure successful application. It does NOT apply for jobs.

session_token.description: Token returned by ncs_login_jobseeker. Required for all tools that act on behalf of a logged-in jobseeker. Not required for ncs_register_jobseeker, ncs_login_jobseeker, ncs_search_jobs, ncs_search_job_fair, ncs_find_career_centre (these are public-facing).

skills.description: List of skills of the jobseeker

name: ncs_search_jobs
description: Searches for available jobs based on filters like sector, qualification, and employment type. Must be called before ncs_apply_job to obtain job_id. It does NOT apply for jobs.

name: ncs_apply_job
description: Applies for a job using a job_id obtained from ncs_search_jobs. Must be called after ncs_login_jobseeker and ncs_update_profile. It does NOT search for jobs or update profile.

session_token.description: Token returned by ncs_login_jobseeker. Required for all tools that act on behalf of a logged-in jobseeker. Not required for ncs_register_jobseeker, ncs_login_jobseeker, ncs_search_jobs, ncs_search_job_fair, ncs_find_career_centre (these are public-facing).

name: ncs_check_application_status
description: Checks the status of a submitted job application. Must be called after ncs_login_jobseeker. It does NOT apply for jobs.

session_token.description: Token returned by ncs_login_jobseeker. Required for all tools that act on behalf of a logged-in jobseeker. Not required for ncs_register_jobseeker, ncs_login_jobseeker, ncs_search_jobs, ncs_search_job_fair, ncs_find_career_centre (these are public-facing).

application_id.description: Unique ID of the job application

name: ncs_search_skill_training
description: Searches for available skill training programs based on filters. Must be called before ncs_enroll_skill_training to obtain course_id. It does NOT enroll in training.

name: ncs_enroll_skill_training
description: Enrolls a jobseeker in a skill training program using course_id from ncs_search_skill_training. Must be called after ncs_login_jobseeker. It does NOT search for courses.

session_token.description: Token returned by ncs_login_jobseeker. Required for all tools that act on behalf of a logged-in jobseeker. Not required for ncs_register_jobseeker, ncs_login_jobseeker, ncs_search_jobs, ncs_search_job_fair, ncs_find_career_centre (these are public-facing).

course_id.description: Unique identifier of the training course

name: ncs_search_job_fair
description: Searches for job fairs based on type and location. Must be called before ncs_register_job_fair to obtain job_fair_id. It does NOT register for job fairs.

name: ncs_register_job_fair
description: Registers a jobseeker for a job fair using job_fair_id from ncs_search_job_fair. Must be called after ncs_login_jobseeker. It does NOT search for job fairs.

session_token.description: Token returned by ncs_login_jobseeker. Required for all tools that act on behalf of a logged-in jobseeker. Not required for ncs_register_jobseeker, ncs_login_jobseeker, ncs_search_jobs, ncs_search_job_fair, ncs_find_career_centre (these are public-facing).

job_fair_id.description: Unique identifier of the job fair

name: ncs_find_career_centre
description: Finds nearby career centers based on location. No prerequisite tools are required. It does NOT register users or apply for jobs.

location.description: Location to search for career centers
